title: Latency-focused sequence-length strata packer with kernel-hint hints
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: Current request coalescing slightly over-buckets long and short sequences into wide pad-heavy microbatches. This increases effective tokens-per-second, raises per-request latency p95/p99 under tail workloads, and increases cost for interactive customers. We need a runtime component that dynamically stratifies incoming requests into sequence-length strata, chooses kernel variants per-stratum, and shapes prefill vs decode scheduling to reduce padding while keeping latency SLOs.

Scope: implement a seqlen strata packer (new microbatcher stage) that: 1) maintains short/medium/long strata with dynamic thresholds derived from recent length histograms, 2) provides kernel-hint metadata to the kernel selector to prefer low-latency kernels for short strata and throughput kernels for long strata, and 3) applies latency-weighted prefill/decode scheduling so short-stride interactive requests are prioritized while long-batch prefill can tolerate slightly higher latency.

This ticket covers design, runtime implementation, offline experiments, canary rollout, and dashboards for evaluation. Implementation MUST be feature-flag guarded and reversible with a rollout plan.
rationale:
Trade-offs: strictly minimizing padding (pure pad-shedding) can cause head-of-line blocking and increase decode latency for short requests. Conversely, aggressive latency-first scheduling can reduce throughput. The strata approach attempts a middle ground: reduce padding within each stratum and use kernel hints to get per-stratum kernel performance benefits. Kernel-hints allow the kernel selector to swap tiling/attention paths or switch QKV fusion heuristics per-stratum without changing model artifacts.

Why new microbatcher stage: existing coalescer has limited visibility into per-stratum dynamics and cannot surface kernel affinity metadata. Adding a lightweight strata layer keeps changes localized and reduces risk to other batching heuristics.
proposed_solution: 1) Runtime: Add a SeqLenStrataPacker between request ingress and existing coalescer. The packer collects a short rolling histogram (exponential decay, 60s window) of request sequence lengths and computes three strata thresholds: short, medium, long. Thresholds are adaptive: short = 10th percentile + floor(2 tokens), long = 90th percentile - floor(2 tokens). 2) Microbatch formation: pack within strata using existing microbatch size target but permit smaller microbatches for short stratum to reduce tail latency. 3) Kernel hints: annotate microbatch metadata with preferred kernel_profile tag ("latency-optimized", "balanced", "throughput-optimized"). Kernel selector uses this tag to bias kernel choice; it remains advisory. 4) Prefill/decode scheduling: scheduler implements latency-weighted queueing: short strata decode work is assigned higher scheduling score; prefill work for long strata is relaxed and may be batched for efficiency. 5) Telemetry: emit per-stratum metrics (requests, avg-seqlen, pad-waste-tokens, p50/p95/p99 latencies, tokens/s) and an overall cost delta metric computed against a baseline.
metrics: Primary success metrics: 1) pad_waste_tokens_per_request: target -20% vs baseline on mixed production traces, 2) p99 decode latency for short-strata: target no regression (within +5%) or improve, 3) tokens_per_second: target >= baseline (throughput neutral or better), 4) per-customer token cost change: target -10% for interactive-heavy customers. Secondary: CPU/GPU utilization and scheduler queue depth.
experiments:
Offline: run packed simulation with production trace replay for last 7 days (trace stored in s3://redwood-prod-traces/2026/02). Compare existing coalescer vs strata packer across customer segments: chat, summarization, batch embeddings.
Online: feature-flagged canary rollout: stage 1 internal-only (10% traffic, internal clusters), stage 2 customer opt-in with A/B split for 5 customers, stage 3 ramp to 30% if metrics good, stage 4 global rollout gated by SLO checks. Each stage runs for at least 48h and requires green checks on pad_waste_tokens, short-strata p99, and tokens/s.
rollout_plan:
- Feature flag gate (runtime flag: runtime.seqlen_strata_packer.enabled)
- Canary cohort selection: low-risk clusters first, then a small set of enterprise customers who agreed to test.
- Observability: new dashboard tile 'Strata Packer — pad waste & latency' + alerts: pad_waste > -10% and short_strata_p99 > baseline * 1.05 => rollback.
- Fallback: runtime can disable packer per-cluster within 30s; kernel-hint is advisory and safe to ignore, so worst-case behavior is equivalent to current coalescer.
implementation_notes:
- Keep kernel_hint as enum string to avoid schema churn. If future: expand to structured hints but behind a config flag.
- Use existing histogram infra in serving runtime (see ENG-29103 for token footprint consolidator heuristics).
- Add unit tests for threshold calculation (simulated histograms), integration test with coalescer to ensure no deadlocks, and load-tests with small-scale perf harness.
- PRs should include microbenchmarks on representative kernels: flash attention vs default attention, 8-bit vs 16-bit quant path, and measure decode latency change per-stratum.
blockers:
- Kernel selector API needs a small extension to accept kernel_hint metadata (blocked on ENG-49872 discussion).
- We need updated perf numbers for new flash-attn variants on A100 (awaiting infra run).
comments: 2026-03-02 Maya Chen: Initial spike completed. Histogram algorithm chosen: exponential-decay with alpha=0.1 over 60s window. Short/long heuristics early results looked promising on replay traces (~18% pad reduction for chat).

2026-03-05 Liam O'Neill: Review feedback — kernel_hint must be advisory; do not force kernel selection, add a grace path if kernel not available. Also asked to quantify CUDA kernel switch cost; added microbench plan.

2026-03-08 Priya Kapoor: Ran offline simulation against last 7 days of traces for 3 medium customers. Results: pad_waste -16% overall, short-strata p99 improved by 7ms, tokens/s +2%. Noted increased scheduler CPU by ~6% in the pilot cluster.
2026-03-11 Engineering Review: Approve design pending small API change to kernel selector. Add an integration test ensuring no head-of-line blocking for long prefill batches.

2026-03-12 Maya Chen: Started implementation of packer stage; added metrics emission and feature flag. Open PR: runtime/pull/1892. Planning small internal canary next week once perf microbenchmarks land.
